record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare PSYCHIC in this production reference, all with passive NONE. The strategy is shared; differences are the star count.
record.summary: Hits the cast target and the cells adjacent to it (a 3x3 block, centre included) that hold enemies of the caster: each gets requested SPECIAL damage 40/80/160 (raw, by stars 1/2/3; 320 for 4+) with AP scaling and the cast's crit flag, then a requested -15 PP (burn), and its manaBurnCount is incremented. A target holding Twist Band has the -15 flipped to +15 by the shared helper.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target) and every enemy of the caster standing in the 8 cells around it; allies of the caster standing in that block are skipped
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read. The cell list is built once before any damage is applied.

geometry.shape: 3x3 block centred on the cast target (adjacent cells with includesCenter true), clipped at the board edge

effects.scaling: requested amount: raw x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: intermediate, not guaranteed final HP damage: handleSpecialDamage returns 0 and deals nothing for an enemy that is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce; otherwise handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) (ceil, min 1) among other steps (shield, Shiny Charm, Fossil, Cover Band, resurrection: shared helper, see core-mechanics.md section A, not re-traced here). The strategy ignores the returned takenDamage. Same damage for the target and each adjacent enemy (no centre bonus).

effects.scaling: none: apBoost 0 and crit false are passed, so neither AP nor crit scales it
effects.resolution: applied change comes from addPP on each enemy after its damage: value = round(-15) = -15 (the fatigue halving applies only to positive values); then applyTwistBandBuff: an enemy holding TWIST_BAND (the caster is on another team) gets +15 instead, which is then blocked by silence, protect or NO_PP_GAIN; a negative change is blocked only for the tree status and for a resurrecting target; otherwise pp = clamp(pp - 15, 0, 2 x maxPP - 1), so the applied loss is at most the current pp. manaBurnCount++ happens for every filtered enemy whatever addPP did. The addPP call comes after handleSpecialDamage, also for an enemy the damage just killed.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (320, also the fallback) is not reachable by the three units' star counts (1, 2, 3). maxPP is 90 and range 2 for all three. The PP loss is 15 for every star.

record.positionalConditions: The 3x3 block is centred on the target's cell, so the hit pattern depends on where the target stands; cells outside the board are skipped. Only enemies of the caster in those cells are affected.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats the damage and the PP loss on whatever enemies are in the block at that moment.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 40/80/160 (1/2/3 stars) per affected enemy and -15 PP. Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x critPower on a crit]; dealt damage is that after the SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and the other handleDamage steps, 0 when blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce. Requested PP change -15; applied PP change is -min(15, current pp) except when the enemy holds Twist Band (+15, subject to the positive-gain blocks and the 2 x maxPP - 1 cap) or has the tree status / is resurrecting (no change).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shield, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers): only the SPE_DEF step was cited; core-mechanics.md section A was consulted for the rest
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate in castAbility was read

Consulted for the PP helpers: PokemonEntity.addPP and applyTwistBandBuff at the pinned commit (core-mechanics.md section B documents PP; Twist Band card via lookup-item was not needed beyond the function text)
unresolved: Whether any item or synergy effect changes PSYCHIC beyond what is listed (Big Eater Belt is applied by addShield-type adders, not by addPP, in the code read)
Resurrection and other death-cancelling paths on a damaged enemy were not enumerated
What manaBurnCount is used for elsewhere (counter only incremented here; its consumers were not searched)
The cast target can be at the edge of the block of an enemy that moved after targeting; only the target's position at cast time is used
